title: Quality and cost
text:
With the latest release, not only were bugs introduced, but features that were previously free now require a subscription. 

Look: I’m fine paying to get rid of ads. I’m even fine to get more features. What I’m NOT fine with are:
- having features I’ve been using for years suddenly put behind a paywall
- a subscription model

You want me to pay, fine; charge me a flat fee. But a subscription for an app I use maybe 2-3 times a month? To heck with that noise. I’ve had it with subscriptions. 

Rethink your changes.
